description: A bed with a dark blue cover and a pale pink pillow is in front, with a gray T‑shirt lying on the bed. The left hand and right hand reach in and grasp the T‑shirt as a two-hand object, lift and spread it flat, then fold one side inward and smooth it before folding again into a smaller rectangle; both hands press and align the edges, and finally the two-hand object is lifted slightly to show the neatly folded shirt.
